title: Fractal basin geometry and the limits to predictability and reproducibility in deep learning
title_zh: 分形盆几何与深度学习可预测性与可再现性的界限
abstract: Abstract Fundamental limits to predictability are central to our understanding of many physical and computational systems. In deep learning, training outcomes are often difficult to predict and reproduce even when extrinsic sources of randomness are controlled, yet the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Here we propose riddled basin geometry as a unifying dynamical systems mechanism: every initialization leading to one solution lies arbitrarily close to initializations leading to different solutions, forming a fat fractal with structure at arbitrarily fine scales. Using a minimal neural network model, we analytically establish the classical route to riddling and derive a near-zero uncertainty exponent: even sharp increases in initialization precision yield only marginal gains in outcome predictability. In deep networks, intertwined training destinations and near-zero parameter-space exponents provide robust signatures consistent with riddling across the tested architectures, optimizers and training protocols, offering a common dynamical account of otherwise disparate empirical observations. We further introduce functional uncertainty exponents, extending these diagnostics of scale-insensitive irreproducibility from parameter space to the learned functions themselves. Together, our results support riddled basin geometry as a candidate organizing principle for irreproducibility in deep learning, with practical implications for optimization and the reliable deployment of artificial intelligence.
abstract_zh: 摘要 深度学习中可预测性的基本界限是对许多物理和计算系统理解的核心。即使在控制外部随机性的情况下，训练结果往往仍难以预测和重现，但其底层机制尚不明确。本文提出“riddled basin”（被撕裂的盆）几何作为一个统一的动力学系统机制：每一个收敛至某一解的初始化点，都与收敛至不同解的初始化点任意接近，形成了具有任意细度结构的“脂”分形。利用极简神经网络模型，我们解析了经典的被撕裂路径，并推导出接近零的不确定性指数：即使初始化精度大幅提高，结果的可预测性也仅有微小提升。在深度网络中，交织的训练目的地和接近零的参数空间指数是一致的，在测试的各种架构、优化器和训练协议中表现出被撕裂的特征，为各种不同的经验观察提供了统一的动力学解释。此外，我们引入了功能不确定性指数，将从参数空间到学习函数本身的尺度不敏感的不可再现性诊断扩展开来。总之，我们的结果支持分形盆几何作为深度学习中不可再现性的候选组织原理，并对优化和人工智能的可靠部署具有实际意义。
